reconciliation_summary.float_note: differences of order 1e-14 caused only by floating-point summation order are not treated as data discrepancies; every per-plane raw difference is recorded in `reconciliation`
reconciliation_summary.note: declared = values written by the router in routes.json; recomputed = four_side_1024.v3.metrics measured from the saved world-mm primitives; differences are reported, never smoothed away

bend_loss.note: no femtosecond-laser-written glass bend-loss function is known; R=40 mm is a geometry constraint only, not a measured loss value

crossing_loss.note: single-layer crossing optical feasibility not confirmed; crossing count is a geometric metric only

loss_policy.legacy_polymer_model: NOT used as glass truth; omission flagged

definitions.straight: no arcs; all straight primitives collinear (single straight run)
definitions.short_S: exactly one historical short-S pair (two reverse theta arcs, theta=acos(1-d/(2R))) and no quarter arcs
definitions.L: exactly one quarter arc (90 deg) plus straight primitives
definitions.U: one net 180-degree turn inside the board: 'wide_U' (two quarter arcs with straight primitives between), 'hairpin' (two consecutive quarter arcs, no straight between), or 'hairpin_short_S' (SAME_HAIRPIN_A/B: one hairpin plus one historical short-S lateral shift, still a single 180-degree same-side U path)
definitions.multi_bend_refold: more than two effective bends: three or more quarter arcs, two or more hairpins, or a short-S combined with additional quarter arcs (folded/refold path)
definitions.other: anything that does not match the families above; in V3 this is the two-quarter step transfer (two quarter arcs with opposite sweeps, net turn 0 deg, the FSLW opposite-side 'U' transfer family), kept as 'other' because the required taxonomy has no step class and 'U' is reserved for net-180-degree U/hairpin paths

notes: every number comes from the per-run statistics.json recomputed from primitives by four_side_1024.v3.metrics; missing runs are marked, never guessed
z1 (CSV row 1) and z2 (CSV row 2) are independent 2D problems at two model heights; cross-plane XY projections are informational only and never violations (SPEC §2)
bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated; only propagation loss is a computed loss number
classification of path shapes never uses the CSV relation/pair label
